albedo:4277961009.description:
Be one of the Bedo 100

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to usher every satellite mission set into this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, between 250 km - 400 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.
As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo’s trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you’re advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on earth.
How We Operate: Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.
Who We're Looking For: Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You’ll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn’t feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.
If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

As Albedo continues to scale, we’re looking for a Head of People to build the systems, processes, and leadership capability that allow the company to grow without losing what makes it special. You’ll own the people function end-to-end, partnering closely with founders and leadership to develop a high-performance culture, support employees and managers, and ensure our people infrastructure scales ahead of company growth. This role is equal parts operator, advisor, and builder — helping Albedo attract, develop, reward, and retain exceptional talent while navigating the realities of a fast-moving aerospace company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end employee experience, including onboarding, offboarding, benefits administration, payroll coordination, HRIS administration, and employee support
  • Ensure compliance with employment laws and HR best practices across hiring, documentation, leave administration, employee relations, worker classification, and performance management
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to employees, managers, and leadership on people-related matters, providing coaching, guidance, and support through both everyday challenges and complex situations
  • Partner with managers and leadership to strengthen management capability across the organization and drive a high-performance culture
  • Lead performance management, compensation philosophy, salary banding, benchmarking, and total rewards programs
  • Own employee relations matters, including investigations, conflict resolution, performance concerns, and disciplinary processes
  • Partner closely with Finance, Legal, and company leadership on payroll, benefits, headcount planning, reporting, and organizational design
  • Plan and execute company events, offsites, and employee experience programs that strengthen culture and reinforce company values
  • Track and report key people metrics, identify organizational risks and opportunities, and use data to inform leadership decisions
  • Support recruiting on an as-needed basis for critical roles, while partnering with the recruiting team that owns hiring execution day-to-day

Your Ideal Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of progressive HR/People experience, including prior ownership of a broad people function; prior Head of People or equivalent title at a company of similar scale strongly preferred
  • Experience building and scaling people infrastructure at a startup, ideally between 50–200 employees, where you had to create structure without losing speed
  • Deep knowledge of HR compliance, employment law, and best practices — including leave administration, worker classification, multi-state compliance, and employee relations — with the judgment to navigate gray areas
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (Rippling preferred), payroll administration, and benefits management
  • Experience designing and running performance management cycles, compensation benchmarking, and engagement and culture initiatives
  • Strong track record partnering directly with founders and senior leadership — comfortable influencing up and pushing back with data when needed
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication — you set the tone for how Albedo communicates with its people
  • Startup experience at the 50–200 person stage; comfort operating with ambiguity, wearing multiple hats, and building process where none exists
  • Prior experience in aerospace, defense, hard tech, or another technical environment is a plus
  • Comfort leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to create leverage and operate efficiently

Salary Range:

  • $140,415 - $187,388 per year

Compensation and Benefits for Full-Time Roles:

    • Employee friendly equity compensation
    • 4% direct matching 401k
    • Health Insurance: 100% employee coverage & 75% dependent coverage
    • Parental leave and childcare coverage
    • Flexible vacation and sick time from day one
    • 12 company holidays
    • $100 monthly wellness benefit
    • Relocation package if not based in Denver
The final compensation package is subject to change if the candidate's experience and company need drive a different job level than originally slated for the position.
Albedo does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Albedo employees. Albedo is not responsible for any fees or overhead related to unsolicited resumes.
Additional Requirements: In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. All persons hired will be required to be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled: Albedo is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Relocation: Relocation support for this position is available
Applicants must be a U.S. Person as defined under 22 CFR 120.62
#LI-Onsite
Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Albedo, we'd rather hear from you. We care more about how you think than which boxes you check. We value people who do the math, make their assumptions explicit, and ask the annoying questions: what breaks, what's the failure mode, what has to be true for this to work? If that sounds like you, apply, even if you don't meet every line.

Role Description

Dropbox is looking for a Program Manager within our People Operations, Rewards, and Technology team (PORT). You will join a talented team to deliver operational services, optimize people processes and ensure that Dropboxers have amazing experience throughout their career. Our best in class PORT team drives strategic HR program initiatives and delivers an excellent employee experience at a fast-growing global capacity. You will thrive working in a fast-paced and customer -focused environment to make an immediate impact and ensure best practices for compliance, effectiveness and efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the global Contingent Workforce program.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for CW processes, escalations, and program-related questions from MSP.
  • Partner with the MSP, suppliers, hiring managers, HR, Legal, Procurement, and other stakeholders to ensure consistent program execution.
  • Monitor program processes, identify gaps and opportunities, and implement improvements that increase efficiency and reduce risk.
  • Maintain and continuously improve CW policies, processes, documentation, and governance.
  • Support reporting, compliance, and program performance tracking.
  • Support ServiceNow enhancements and updates.
  • You’ll work with Dropbox vendors to troubleshoot and resolve day to day issues/inquiries.
  • You’ll develop and ensure standard HR operating procedures are in place with clear SLAs
  • You’ll collaborate with partners in HR, Recruiting, and Finance to conduct root cause analysis and develop corrective action plans when issues arise, ensuring the highest quality employee experience
  • You’ll work closely with the HR Project Managers to support project execution and continuous process improvement and onboarding and Contingent workforce operations.
  • You’ll maintain documentation for each part of the service, and drive communication outwards to stakeholders when necessary.
  • You’ll identify and make recommendations on program/process changes and conduct cost/benefit analysis of potential operational improvements.
  • You’ll support ad-hoc HR Ops tasks and reporting.
  • Work cross collaboratively across all regions with the respective onboarding team.
  • You’ll create SOPs and Job Aids when necessary for documentation and to streamline processes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in HR Operations/HR administration in a fast-paced environment
  • Problem solving, critical thinking and troubleshooting abilities
  • Experience in Workday and HR Operations service request management
  • Strong customer-service skills with proven track record of customer satisfaction
  • Proficiency in Office Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point), Gmail and Google Docs
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with ServiceNow

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

engine:7829840003.description:
About Engine

At Engine, we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we’re here to change that. We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That’s why we’re building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

As a People Business Partner at Engine, you own the People partnership for a defined client group — from individual contributors up through Sr Managers — within one of our fastest-moving parts of the business. You coach and advise managers, run the core people cycles, handle employee relations with objectivity, fairness, empathy and manage the tactical work that keeps the org healthy. You work alongside a Sr People Business Partner who owns the most senior and strategic layer, so you can own everything below that line and escalate cleanly when work crosses it.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is organized, credible with managers, and steady in a high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. Within your first few months, you'll become the managers' trusted go-to for people questions and take full ownership of the tactical engine and people cycles for your client group.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with and coach people managers up to Sr Manager on team health, performance, development, and day-to-day people decisions — earning credibility and influencing sound outcomes.
  • Bring business context to your partnership: understand your client group's operational and financial goals, and align People programs and processes to them.
  • Run the core people cycles end to end — performance reviews, calibration prep, comp cycle, and org-health insights — coaching managers through each.
  • Own employee relations from IC through Sr Manager: handle grievances and conflict with empathy and fairness, navigate difficult topics, and escalate complex or senior-level matters to PBP leadership.
  • Consult with managers on team-level structure and effectiveness, and partner with the Sr PBP on larger org changes.
  • Interpret org-health data to find root causes, anticipate risks, and give managers clear, actionable insight.
  • Execute org and change initiatives independently as needed, and in partnership with PBP Leaders, using data and context to keep transitions moving.
  • Translate policy and compliance into everyday practice, escalating higher-risk matters appropriately.
  • Manage the tactical workload end to end — HiBob workforce planning and reqs, headcount reconciliation, JD and Greenhouse support, on/offboarding, transitions, and termination prep — and provide backup coverage for a paired team so no group goes dark.
  • Communicate clearly and build trust across teams, coaching managers on how to communicate through change.

What You'll Bring to Engine:

  • ~4–6 years in HRBP / People Partner roles with direct client-group support and hands-on manager coaching — including at least 2 years supporting either a Product Development org (Engineering, Data, Product) or a GTM / Revenue org (Sales, Finance, Business Development) in a high-growth environment.
  • Practical employee-relations experience through mid-management, with sound judgment on when to act and when to escalate.
  • Strong organization and process discipline — comfortable owning cyclical people processes end to end.
  • Business acumen to connect People work to what the business is trying to achieve.
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong, trusted relationships with stakeholders to influence outcomes.
  • Fluency with HRIS, ATS, and analytics tools (e.g., HiBob, Greenhouse, Looker, or similar).
  • Comfortable in a rapidly changing environment, able to manage multiple priorities and pivot as needed.

Applications for this role will be accepted through 12/8/26 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation

Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, total compensation may include equity and/or variable pay (OTE). Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$110,000—$140,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with opportunities for bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture.
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we’ll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more.

Ready to Build the Future of Work Travel?
Join us on our mission to transform how work travel works—for businesses, for travelers, and for the industry. Apply now and let’s make travel simpler, smarter, and more enjoyable—together.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

As the Senior Director, People Business Partners, you'll serve as a strategic business partner to multiple C-level executives. You will lead a team of experienced global PBPs who support executive leadership. You'll report to the VP, People Business Partners and translate business priorities into talent strategies that help GitLab scale a high-performing, values-driven technical organization in a fully remote environment. You'll drive organizational transformation and change management, including designing organization structures, building leadership capability, and embedding scalable people practices.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the senior people partner to several of GitLab's C-level executives and their executive teams, building the trust and credibility needed to shape and execute a global people strategy that accelerates teams' growth, performance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Architect and lead large-scale organizational transformation, including organizational design, workforce planning, and change management with the rigor and urgency required to keep pace with rapid shifts in how AI is reshaping the business and the team.
  • Experience advising global engineering teams with on-call responsibilities.
  • Drive talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development ensuring the organization has the leadership depth and critical skills needed to execute on its long-term roadmap.
  • Bring people analytics to leadership, providing clear line of sight into organizational health including capability gaps, leadership effectiveness, and critical talent retention; translate those insights into strategic recommendations that drive performance and decision-making.
  • Provide direct, candid coaching and counsel to executives and senior leaders on leadership effectiveness, team dynamics, and navigating complex organizational and people challenges.
  • Partner with Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management & Development, and People Operations to ensure talent needs are reflected in company-wide people programs, policies, and investments.
  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of People Business Partners — setting a clear vision, building a culture of coaching and accountability, and ensuring each team member is positioned to do their best and most impactful work.

What you'll bring

  • Proven track record of leading people strategy through significant organizational transformation, including AI-driven workforce shifts, rapid scaling, or major technology pivots within enterprise technology or SaaS environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of Product/Engineering, Finance, Total Rewards, and Talent Acquisition building alignment across competing priorities and influencing decisions without direct authority in a fast-moving, global organization.
  • Experience building and scaling a People Business Partner team, including raising the bar on strategic impact, and developing PBPs to operate as true business partners to senior leaders.
  • Executive-level presence and credibility, with the ability to advise C-suite and VP-level leaders with candor and confidence especially in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
  • Proven ability to lead effectively across time zones, building aligned, engaged, and accountable teams in a fully remote environment.

About the team

The People Business Partner team at GitLab sits at the intersection of people strategy and business execution. We partner directly with senior leaders to shape talent strategy, drive organizational effectiveness, and build the leadership and cultural foundations that allow GitLab to perform at its best.

highwire:4390637009.description:
The Senior Manager, People Operations is a highly experienced, hands-on leader responsible for three critical areas of Highwire’s People function: payroll and payroll tax; benefits and retirement programs; and people analytics.

This role sits at the intersection of People, Finance and business operations. It translates complex workforce and financial data into actionable insights, strengthens the controls connecting People and Finance, and designs benefits programs and communication strategies that employees can understand and value.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business judgment, exceptional attention to detail and the ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution. This person will serve as a trusted partner to People leadership, Finance, senior leaders, brokers, vendors and employees while continuously improving the systems and processes that support our growing, multistate workforce.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll, Tax and Financial Operations

  • Own the end-to-end administration of accurate, timely and compliant semi-monthly payroll for a multistate workforce, including regular and off-cycle payrolls, variable compensation, deductions, garnishments and employee changes.
  • Serve as Highwire’s internal payroll subject-matter expert and primary administrator for Rippling, our payroll provider, including payroll configuration, employee and tax setup, reporting, integrations and issue resolution.
  • Manage the relationship with Rippling, monitor service performance and coordinate the timely resolution of payroll, tax, system and integration issues.
  • Lead federal, state and local payroll tax administration, including registrations, filings, notices, amendments, quarter-end and year-end processing, W-2s and jurisdictional requirements.
  • Maintain rigorous payroll controls, review protocols, documentation and audit trails that reduce risk and ensure data accuracy.
  • Research and resolve complex payroll, tax, timekeeping and pay-related matters with urgency, discretion and clear employee communication.
  • Partner closely with Finance on payroll funding, general ledger mapping, reconciliations, accruals, invoices, workforce cost reporting, audits and forecasting.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and translate changes into compliant payroll practices, system configurations and employee communications.

Benefits Strategy, Plan Design and Communication

  • Lead the strategy, design, financial evaluation and administration of Highwire’s health, welfare and related benefit programs, balancing employee value, market competitiveness, cost and organizational priorities.
  • Partner with brokers, carriers and Finance on renewals, plan modeling, employee contribution strategy, vendor selection, implementation and ongoing performance management.
  • Analyze claims, utilization, enrollment, benchmarking and employee feedback to evaluate plan performance and recommend thoughtful program enhancements.
  • Develop and execute a year-round benefits communication and education strategy, including open enrollment, plan changes, decision-support resources and targeted campaigns.

People Analytics and Workforce Insights

People Systems and Operational Excellence

Nurse Practitioner - Asynchronous Care

Department: Nurse Practitioner
Reports to: Clinical Manager
Employment type: Full-time, exempt
Schedule: 1.0 FTE (40 hours per week), Monday–Sunday based on business needs
Compensation: $100,000–$115,000 annually
Location: Remote; all work must be completed within the United States

About the Role

The Async Nurse Practitioner provides patient-centered clinical care through inbox management, prescription processing, lab and diagnostic review, and urgent visit coverage. This role helps ensure patients receive timely care, safe medication management, and clear, supportive communication while advancing clinical quality and operational efficiency across IWC.

Working primarily in an asynchronous environment, the NP responds to patient messages, manages medication and refill requests, reviews critical results, and transitions patients to same-day or next-day visits when direct evaluation is needed.

What You’ll Do

Patient Messaging and Care Coordination

  • Manage the Coverage Inbox, including patient questions, follow-up needs, and symptom-related messages

  • Assess patient needs and route messages appropriately

  • Collaborate with clinicians and other members of the care team as needed

  • Provide patients with clear, supportive communication, education, and next steps

  • Maintain timely and accurate documentation of patient interactions and care plans

Prescription Support

  • Review and process asynchronous prescription and refill requests within the scope of licensure

  • Evaluate requests for clinical appropriateness, accuracy, and safety

  • Ensure all prescribing decisions and follow-up plans are appropriately documented

  • Help streamline patients’ access to medications while maintaining clinical quality and compliance

Lab and Safety Review

  • Review flagged and critical laboratory results and other inbound diagnostics

  • Determine and initiate appropriate clinical follow-up

  • Escalate urgent or complex findings when needed

  • Document clinical decisions, patient communication, and plans of care

Same-Day and Next-Day Visits

  • Conduct same-day and next-day visits when urgent needs or inbox concerns require direct evaluation

  • Provide timely assessment, treatment, and patient education

  • Support continuity of care by appropriately transitioning patients from asynchronous messaging to synchronous visits

Just-in-Time Clinical and Project Support

  • Provide clinical support in response to emerging patient-care and business needs

  • Participate in project-based clinical work, including critical lab follow-up and review of inbound diagnostics

  • Contribute to initiatives that improve care quality, patient safety, and operational efficiency

Approximate Work Allocation

Work allocation may change based on patient volume and business needs.

  • 60%: Coverage Inbox and patient communication

  • 20%: Same-day and next-day visits

  • 10%: Asynchronous prescription processing

  • 10%: Just-in-time clinical and project-based work, including critical lab review, follow-up, and inbound diagnostic review

Qualifications

  • Active national board certification as a Nurse Practitioner

  • Licensure requirements: Active, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner licensure and prescriptive authority in a minimum of five (5) U.S. states, including at least one of the following: California, New Jersey. Additional active state licenses are preferred, with strong preference given to candidates licensed in ten (10) or more states. State licensure requirements are subject to change based on business needs.

  • Minimum of three (3) years of clinical experience independently managing perimenopause, menopause, and hormone replacement therapy, including prescribing and titrating estrogen, progesterone, and testosterone

  • Minimum of one (1) year of clinical experience evaluating, prescribing, and monitoring pharmacologic obesity treatments, including GLP-1 agonists

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience autonomously managing a longitudinal patient panel, including independent diagnostic ordering, lab review, and therapeutic planning, without routine physician co-management except where collaboration or supervision is required by state law

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience delivering synchronous telehealth in a remote, non-clinic-based, productivity-driven environment

  • Demonstrated ability to operate multiple systems simultaneously, including an EHR, video-conferencing software, clinical decision-support systems, AI scribe tools, and communication platforms such as Slack and Notion

  • Asynchronous patient-care experience strongly preferred

  • Ability to communicate clearly, compassionately, and efficiently in a written-first clinical environment

  • Strong clinical judgment, organizational skills, and attention to detail

Working Conditions

  • Remote, virtual work environment

  • Reliable, secure internet connection required

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use

  • Extended time working across multiple digital platforms

The Midi Health People team is growing fast, and we need someone to build the operating system that powers it. About Nametag

Nametag is building the future of secure digital identity. Our mission is to protect every human identity to restore trust in the AI era. We bring workforce-grade identity verification integrated to the enterprise to verify the human behind accounts and critical actions. Today, many of the world’s leading brands have a Nametag for every global employee, preventing social engineering and deepfake impersonation attacks.

The role

We’re hiring a Head of People to own the full employee lifecycle and build our People function for scale. You'll be the human face of People at Nametag — the person employees call, trust, and turn to — while building the systems and automations that mean you're rarely doing the same thing twice. You’ll lead a TA hire who executes day-to-day recruiting while you architect the strategy, systems, frameworks, and operational infrastructure that let Nametag hire and retain great people as we grow. This is a builder-leader role: equal parts strategic design and hands-on execution, with a clear path to expand the People team.

What you’ll do

People Operations & Infrastructure (60%)

  • Own and optimize the People tech stack: HRIS, ATS, onboarding tools, and benefits platforms—selecting, implementing, and maintaining systems that scale with the company.
  • Build the policy and documentation framework: employee handbook, job architecture, comp bands, performance review cadence, and PIP process—designed once, scalable forever.
  • Design a remote-first onboarding experience that embeds culture and accelerates ramp; ensure multi-state compliance for a distributed U.S. workforce.
  • Lead engagement, internal communications, and culture programming—including quarterly off-sites—grounded in data (eNPS, pulse surveys) not intuition.
  • Default to automation: build self-service workflows, eliminate manual repetition, and document systems so the team never depends on tribal knowledge.

Talent Acquisition (20%)

  • Manage and develop a TA hire who runs day-to-day sourcing, interviewing, and coordination across Engineering, Product, and GTM.
  • Own recruiting infrastructure: ATS configuration, interview loop design, scorecards, offer frameworks, and employer brand positioning.
  • Set and maintain the hiring bar: calibrate interviewers, close executive-level candidates, and ensure quality and consistency across all pipelines.
  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning: role definition, headcount prioritization, level stratification, and comp band strategy.

Employee Experience & Relations (20%)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employee questions, concerns, and sensitive situations — handling them directly, not routing them to an FAQ.
  • Partner with managers on performance conversations, coaching, and team dynamics before they escalate.
  • Run the feedback loops — 1:1s, exit interviews, pulse data — that keep leadership informed without surprises.
  • Be the person employees trust to listen first and act with discretion.

Ideal qualifications

  • 6–10 years in People/HR at fast-moving startups; prior experience managing or mentoring TA or HR coordinators preferred.
  • Proven systems builder—you’ve selected and implemented HRIS, ATS, and People tooling from scratch, not just administered inherited stacks.
  • Automation-first mindset — your default question is "how do we not do this manually next time," and you have examples of workflows or self-service systems you've built to prove it.
  • Strong operational and program management discipline—you design frameworks that hold up under growth and document decisions so the team doesn’t depend on tribal knowledge.
  • Deep enough TA fluency to set the hiring bar, close executive candidates, and coach your recruiter—without being the one running every search.
  • Experienced with remote-first distributed teams; excellent communicator comfortable writing policy, presenting to leadership, and representing Nametag externally.
  • High EQ and genuine care for people — you handle sensitive situations with discretion, and employees feel it.

What we value

  • Fast technical learning and curiosity about identity security.
  • Kindness, integrity, and high trust—our core operating principles.
  • Bias for action: iterate quickly and ship pragmatic solutions.

Compensation & perks

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision.
  • Remote-first with flexible PTO.
  • Annual team off-sites.
  • New MacBook and home-office equipment.

If you are a people person who is practical-minded;

If you are passionate and business oriented;

If you are excited about transforming and optimizing the People & Culture function with AI;

If you’re not afraid of building stuff from the ground up; and

If you believe what Peter Drucker said – that culture eats strategy for breakfast –

  • Develop and implement HR initiatives that support the company's values and promote a positive and inclusive culture - specifically own and drive our DEI initiatives and programs.

If you have reached this point and you are super excited but not sure you check all the boxes - we still want to speak with you! Your passion is priceless. Other things can be learned.
